items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: a trumpet player by the name of Lloyd Hunter and Don Byas come in

ctx.x: Who all can you remember jamming at Nellie's?

I can remember these, two tenor players I was telling you about. Bob [Dawes] and Andy Anderson were there and Washington out of Earl Hines band was there. And a trumpet player by the name of Lloyd Hunter and Don Byas come in and wiped out everybody (laughter) because see they were trying to see how many choruses they could play, you know, in jamming and when Don Byas came down here, he changed things around.

Like you had to go through the keys every tune that you played, you had to play it in every key. Every night, he would end up with just him and the drummer on the bandstand (laughter). And he went to Chicago and did this at the Club 'Duluxa' run everybody off the bandstand, he went to New York and did it,
